target.statement: ESpeW achieves p-value < 10^-11, Δcos = 51.57%, Δl2 = -103.13%, and ACC = 93.23% on SST2 under CSE with K=50.

compute.basis: Requires querying OpenAI's text-embedding-002 API for ~67k SST2 samples, training a BERT-base stealer model on CPU (several hours), and running CSE removal and evaluation; no GPU strictly needed but CPU training is slow.

blockers: Requires OpenAI API key and budget for text-embedding-002 queries
Code repository link points to Stella model, not the paper's implementation
No official code release for ESpeW or baselines
title: Robust and Minimally Invasive Watermarking for EaaS
